{{Top|leg}}
'''Helical-motion extrapolators''' were components used in [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]]. The [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Judicator/Legends|Judicator]]'' was outfitted with targeting computers that incorporated helical-motion extrapolators alongside antenna locking and in-line calibration.<ref name="CCG-Judicator">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=''Judicator''}}</ref>
